title: what you do and the home you live in

payload_json.topic: what you do and the home you live in
questions: First of all, are you working or studying at the moment?
Is it something you'd choose again?
Is there anything about it you'd change if you could?
Now, your home. Do you live on your own or with other people?
Do most people your age where you live still live with family?
Do you think it matters how big a home is?

teaching.tense_focus: present simple, second conditional in the middle, generalising present at the end
teaching.band_move: On the 'would you choose again' question, answer the question asked — commit before you qualify.

questions.answer_shape: Say which one, name it, then say how many years you've been at it.
questions.extend_move: I'm working — I've been a chef in a hotel kitchen for going on five years now.

common_error.wrong: I am chef since five years.
common_error.right: I've been a chef for five years.
common_error.why: 'For' with a length; jobs take an article.

questions.answer_shape: Say yes or no first, give the reason, then one thing you'd do differently.
questions.extend_move: I would, yes — though I'd train somewhere smaller first, because you learn more.

common_error.wrong: Yes, I choose it again because I like.
common_error.right: Yes, I'd choose it again because I enjoy it.

questions.answer_shape: Pick one thing, say what it costs you now, keep it to your own job.
questions.extend_move: The hours, easily — if the shifts finished an hour earlier I'd actually see people.

common_error.wrong: If I can change, I will finish earlier.
common_error.right: If I could change one thing, I'd finish earlier.
common_error.why: Hypothetical: past form in the if-clause.

questions.answer_shape: Say who's there, name the arrangement, then say how long it's been that way.
questions.extend_move: With two friends from college — we've been in the same flat since the lease started.

common_error.wrong: I live with my two friends since two years.
common_error.right: I've lived with two friends for two years.
common_error.why: 'For' plus a length, and no possessive needed.

questions.answer_shape: Give a quantifier, name the reason people stay, then note the exception.
questions.extend_move: A fair number do, mainly because rents are high — though it's less common than it was.

common_error.wrong: The most of young people live with the family.
common_error.right: Most young people live with their families.

questions.answer_shape: Take a position, name what actually matters instead, then hedge once.
questions.extend_move: Less than people think — a small place laid out well beats a big place you can't heat.

common_error.wrong: The size of home are not important.
common_error.right: The size of a home isn't that important.
common_error.why: The subject is 'size', which is singular.
